en: {fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I'm fine. I'm not tired...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I'm not hungry. Are you hungry, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Not yet... Once we're a little further along.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does being with me tire you out?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You ask strange things, Angel. Don't worry about it... When I don't like something, I'll say so.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we hurry a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Right. I want to rest soon anyway... I'll hurry, then.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you'd like to do right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Not really... Whatever I want to do, I do right away. There's nothing now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}When I'm dancing. I don't have to think about anything...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}.... Not really. Not much.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Really? That's the first time anyone's said that to me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}I don't... think that...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you thirsty?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I'm fine. But let's have something to drink later. All right, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't like them much. Just walking, that is...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Am I? This much is normal, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Let me see... I have wished it... yes...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I wish it all the time...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you ever go to watch dancing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Of course. Watching all kinds of dances is fun.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you all right traveling by ship or horse?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yes, I'm fine. I even dance on ships sometimes.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there something else you want?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I just wondered what you were up to.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}What, you ask... I'm just going to sleep today... honestly...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you for your hard work today.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}...Look... You don't have to come all this way to say that...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I... intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}You want me to say it plainly...? ...Then I will. You're in the way.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...That's what I intend to do. That's enough now, isn't it...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought we might talk a little...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Angel... are you worrying about me? ...If so, no thank you. I want to sleep...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're not drinking tonight?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}No... I'm not in the mood today...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like the night?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}What, all of a sudden... ...Well, I don't dislike the night. Just because... heh heh.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FF81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there something else you need?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Something delicious. I can splurge on a meal at least, can't I, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Heh heh, what's this? Are you treating me, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just go for a meal a little while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}How rude...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}It does. Aren't you getting hungry too, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Do angels have to worry about that sort of thing too...? How tiresome...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you cook?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Oh my... Do I have to answer even that?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'd love to try your cooking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}I don't mind... But it'll cost you.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Done? Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Heh heh... What's this? You want to come out and play too, Angel? But... next time.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yes, that's right. At times like this, you need some diversion.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Not bad. Though that depends on your requests.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Heh heh. Do I look it? Then maybe I am...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Thank you for looking out for me, Angel.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to have a drink?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}Honestly... Stop talking about drinking all the time... It's not like that...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a trick to having fun?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Oh, you're curious about that sort of thing too, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Then I'll teach you properly next time.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else...? Is there something?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}.... I don't need your concern right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks hard. Why not rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}It's fine... I decide things for myself...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Let me see... I'll keep going until I'm satisfied.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Learning something every day is important, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}Don't be so stiff at a time like this. It deflates me...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}...Would it have been better if I hadn't come?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}What's wrong, Angel...? You're acting strange.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That attack looks powerful.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Does it? I hope so. ...If I'm going to fight, I should finish them off painlessly...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look lovely training, too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}...Honestly. You say the most deflating things...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Let me see... I'll keep going until I'm satisfied.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You look lovely training, too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}What are you saying, honestly...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}The breeze feels nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Yes. It really feels nice...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I'm fine. I can keep going. I'll do my best!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Oh, I'm fine. I'm sorry to make you worry.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Oh, I'm fine! Really. Truly.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does being with me tire you out?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Not at all! You talk with me about all sorts of things, so I'm really happy.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we hurry a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Oh, yes. I'm sorry...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you'd like to do right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Something I'd like to do? ...Laundry, or cooking...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Huh? It's all housework.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}When I'm at home talking with Grandfather and Grandmother.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Huh? Oh, yes. I try to be careful so I can be useful to you, Angel... I think.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Really? It makes me kind of happy to hear you say that.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}.... I don't really think so...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you thirsty?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm fine, but... maybe we should rest a little?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yes, very much. Walks feel so nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Oh, I-I'm sorry!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm always slow at walking... I'm trying, but is it no good...?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yes, I have. I've wished it for a long, long time.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you scared of going to towns you don't know?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Going alone is a little scary...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But I find new foods, and they sell handy tools... So I'm all right.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like the sea and the mountains?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, I like both. I haven't been to the sea much. But I like it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I haven't decided. I think anything I can eat is fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh, yes. I don't mind. Aren't you busy, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just go for a meal a little while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}...I didn't go. I was worried about the weather, so I went to look at the clouds.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}It does. Smelling something this good makes my stomach growl.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Oh, so you worry about that sort of thing too, Angel. I'm glad.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there something you really love?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}I love fruit. I often buy some in town and eat it. Not only that, of course.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like eating at restaurants?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Well... to tell the truth, I don't... like it much.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I think who you eat with matters more than where you eat.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}I haven't decided. I think anything I can eat is fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2980}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Oh, so you worry about that sort of thing too, Angel. I'm glad.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}You're tired too, Angel. If you don't mind being with me, I'd be glad to.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yes, thank you. I'll keep doing my best, so please count on me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Um, oh, I'm all right. Not bad.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Oh, r-really? Did I look that excited?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yes, thank you. You should rest sometimes too, Angel. Please take care of yourself.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there somewhere you used to go often?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Let me see. I used to go to the lake with Grandfather and Grandmother.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Listening to the little birds sing by the lakeshore feels so nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you ever dress up?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}What, me!? W-w-well...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I've never... really thought about it...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
